title: Singaporean and Permanent Resident Households with Electricity and Water Bills in Arrears
what_it_is: Singaporean and Permanent Resident Households with Electricity and Water Bills in Arrears

sections.label: Water arrears and flow restrictors
sections.summary: Of 150,000 households, about 1,200 have arrears of at least $250, and PUB has installed flow restrictors to reduce their water flow rate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Of these 150,000 households, about 1,200 have arrears of at least $250.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: For these households, the Public Utilities Board (PUB) has installed flow restrictors to reduce the flow rate of water to their premises.

sections.label: Pay-as-You-Use scheme for utilities
sections.summary: The PAYU scheme requires pre-paid credits, with 20% going to arrears; PUB's water trial has 50 households and data will inform any extension.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Pay-as-You-Use (PAYU) scheme is currently offered to electricity customers who have accumulated at least $400 of overdue payment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under the PAYU scheme, households would have to pre-pay for credits to use electricity and 20% of the credit payment would go towards settling outstanding arrears.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since August 2021, PUB has commenced a trial to implement the PAYU scheme for water, and 50 households are currently participating in this trial.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Similar to the electricity PAYU scheme, households under the water PAYU scheme will be able to access water at the normal flow rate through pre-paying for credits, 20% of which goes towards settling their arrears.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: PUB will continue to gather data from the trial, before making a decision on whether to extend the scheme to more households.
